follow-up time: Through the completion of the hepatitis B vaccine course
outcome: Infant immune response to hepatitis B vaccine
cohort: 1254 infants born in Jinchang City during 2018-2019 whose parents were both HBsAg negative
finding: Cesarean section and birth weight <3.18 kg were independent risk factors for infant non-response to HepB, while cesarean section, formula feeding, maternal anti-HBs negativity, paternal non-response history of HepB, and birth weight <3.22 kg were independent risk factors for infant low response to HepB.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was an independent risk factor for both infant non-response and low response to the hepatitis B vaccine.
followup_time: Through completion of hepatitis B vaccine course
birth_weight: Categorized as <3.18 kg, <3.22 kg, and ≥3.18 kg/≥3.22 kg
